maintenance_led.reason: Mostly rents downhole drilling tools to oil and gas operators; inspection services and tool sales are the smaller parts.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private oil, gas and geothermal operators and service companies, not government agencies.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly from renting more tools; acquisitions like Deep Casing Tools and Superior Drilling Products are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Rental drilling tools such as stabilizers and reamers are largely interchangeable, so operators can change suppliers easily.
